name: Permanent Residence (Radicación)

requirements.blocker_text: MERCOSUR nationals need 2 years of valid temporary residence before applying for permanent residence.
requirements.fix_path: Accumulate 2 years of valid temporary residence.

requirements.blocker_text: Non-MERCOSUR nationals need 3 years of valid temporary residence before applying for permanent residence.
requirements.fix_path: Accumulate 3 years of valid temporary residence.

evidence_required.document: Proof of physical presence exceeding 50% of the authorized residence period
Valid temporary residence documentation for the full qualifying period

outcome.physical_presence_requirement: Must be physically present in Argentina for more than 50% of the authorized residence period to transition from temporary to permanent status.

sources.title: Dirección Nacional de Migraciones -- Preguntas Frecuentes Residencias: 2-year (MERCOSUR) vs. 3-year (non-MERCOSUR) temporary residence thresholds for permanent residence, 50%+ physical presence requirement, RaDEX-only applications

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Argentina). Also confirmed on this same source but not modeled as separate requirement_groups here, since they are alternate qualifying bases rather than typical applicant paths: descent from an Argentine national (native, naturalized, or by-option) grants direct eligibility for permanent residence; recognized refugees with sufficient territorial attachment qualify; Brazilian nationals have a distinct basis under Law 26.240. citizenship_after_months modeled as 0 here because Ley 346's 2-year continuous-legal-residence naturalization bar (see ar_naturalisation.json) is typically already satisfied by the time someone reaches permanent residence via the non-MERCOSUR 3-year track, and exactly satisfied for MERCOSUR nationals at the 2-year mark -- naturalization eligibility does not require holding permanent residence specifically, only continuous legal residence, so the two tracks can complete close together rather than strictly sequentially.
